platform_ambiguity: Platform values follow corpus page directories: common means pages/common/*; osx corresponds to pages/osx/*. The common bucket is a corpus platform category, not a claim that an operation works on every OS.

provenance.authoring_method: source-backed scenario families with five paraphrases each
provenance.intent_record: Prompts were drafted from the pinned parser-v4 source examples and platform corpus inventory before any retrieval run on this cohort. The authoring agent was instructed not to inspect holdout data or retrieval outputs.
provenance.scope: development-only; not a holdout or release dataset

split_policy: development-only cohort; twelve new scenario families; five tasks per family; thirty answerable and thirty unanswerable tasks
